question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Sacred
solution: The correct answer is **'Consecrated.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let us see the meaning of Sacred: • Sacred: connected with God, a god or religion. (ईश्‍वर, किसी देवता या धर्म से संबंधित) • Let us see the meanings of the given options: • **Consecrated: **to state formally in a special ceremony that a place or an object can be used for religious purposes. (धार्मिक उद्देश्‍य से किसी स्‍थान या वस्‍तु को औपचारिक रूप से संस्‍कारित करना) • **Submissive: **ready to obey other people and do whatever they want. (आज्ञाकारी, नम्र, दब्‍बू) • **Passionate: **showing or caused by very strong feelings. (भावावेशपूर्ण) • **Adamant: **very sure; refusing to change your mind. (अपने मत पर अटल, दृढ़; अड़ियल) • From the meanings of the given words, we can say that the word** "Consecrated"** is the appropriate synonym for the word "Sacred​." • Hence, the correct answer is Option 1. 45:Tb39, The correct answer is **'Dermatology.'**
